visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a medium shot of a young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white camisole and a red and white plaid mini-skirt. She is leaning back on a wooden bench in an outdoor urban plaza, smiling broadly at the camera. Behind her, a massive Ferris wheel with the AIA logo and 'HEALTHIER' text dominates the skyline under a bright, twilight sky. The lighting is warm and natural, transitioning into evening artificial illumination. (2) The scene shifts into a series of rapid cuts or short sequences where the woman performs various poses. She raises her arm towards the Ferris wheel, looks over her shoulder while walking away, and sits on the bench again, leaning deeply back. Each pose is accompanied by large Traditional Chinese text overlays appearing in the center and top of the frame. (3) The final sequence shows a montage of stylized still photos and brief clips of the woman in the same environment. She poses with a red handbag, raises both arms in excitement, and holds her hand out toward the lens in a 'high five' gesture. The camera remains mostly static or with very slight handheld movement, maintaining a focus on the subject's energetic expressions and the architectural background of the city skyline and amusement wheel.
